summary: Adds a Question Bank to every Lesson from Week 2 to Week 16 (Week 1 already had them), so every Lesson now has a Lesson Quiz. Each bank was researched against the official docs for its tools, and the 196 Materials those Questions cite are added. Five Lessons and one Milestone are revised where the field has moved: MCP revision 2026-07-28 (no `initialize` handshake, Multi Round-Trip Requests, Sampling, Roots and Logging deprecated), AI SDK 6's deprecation of `generateObject`, App Runner closing to new customers in favour of ECS Express Mode, and Claude's newer Messages API endpoint on Bedrock. Seven Materials whose docs moved get their current URLs.
